name: Demon Hunt
source:
Play as Cisaya, a self-proclaimed demon slayer on her quest to kill the infamous demons residing in Xsainu Castle. Decide how you will gain their trust and get close to each of them. Do you think you can deceive a demon without deceiving yourself?

[From [url=http://samuraiflame.deviantart.com/art/Demon-Hunt-Chapter-1-208704006]Demon Hunt: Chapter 1[/url]]
translation:
扮演西萨亚，一位自称为恶魔杀手的人，致力于杀死居住在Xsainu城堡中的臭名昭著的恶魔。决定如何赢得他们的信任并接近他们每个人。你以为你能欺骗恶魔而不欺骗自己吗？

[来自[url=http://samuraiflame.deviantart.com/art/Demon-Hunt-Chapter-1-208704006]恶魔狩猎：第1章[/url]]
